svg.title: Acid-catalyzed amide hydrolysis: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: CH3C(OH)(OH2+)NH2 + water → CH3C(OH)2NH3+. Solvent removes an O proton and transfers a proton to N. The relay is grouped; it does not create an isolated neutral amide anion.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Solvent removes an O proton and transfers a proton to N. The relay is grouped; it does not create an isolated neutral amide anion.
